import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int Mod;
    static int n, k;
    static long[] fact;
    static long[] inv_fact;
    static long[] inv;
    static long[][] dp;
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 250005;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        Mod = sc.nextInt();

        if (n % 2 == 1) {
            System.out.println(power(k, n));
            sc.close();
            return;
        }

        fact = new long[MAX_SIZE];
        inv_fact = new long[MAX_SIZE];
        inv = new long[MAX_SIZE];
        dp = new long[19][n + 1];

        // Initialize dp with -1
        for (int i = 0; i <= 18; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }

        fact[0] = inv_fact[0] = fact[1] = inv_fact[1] = inv[1] = 1;

        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % Mod;
            inv[i] = (long) ((Mod - Mod / i) * inv[Mod % i] % Mod);
            inv_fact[i] = (inv_fact[i - 1] * inv[i]) % Mod;
        }

        long result = (power(k, n) - recursive(0, n) + Mod) % Mod;
        System.out.println(result);
        sc.close();
    }

    static long power(int base, int exp) {
        long res = 1;
        long cur = base;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * cur) % Mod;
            }
            cur = (cur * cur) % Mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static long recursive(int used, int subset) {
        if (dp[used][subset] != -1) {
            return dp[used][subset];
        }
        long total = 0;
        if (subset == 0) {
            total = fact[n];
            for (int i = 1; i <= used; i++) {
                total = (total * (k - i + 1)) % Mod;
            }
            return dp[used][subset] = total;
        }
        if (used > k) {
            return 0;
        }
        int lowest_bit = subset & (-subset);
        int remaining = subset - lowest_bit;
        for (int T = remaining; ; T = (T - 1) & remaining) {
            total = (total + inv_fact[subset - T] * recursive(used + 1, T) % Mod) % Mod;
            if (T == 0) break;
        }
        return dp[used][subset] = total;
    }
}
